definitions.gloss: land price; cost of land; price paid for land
definitions.explanation: The monetary cost or price of a piece of land, especially in the context of purchase or rental. Distinguished from the cost of the building itself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都心|としん}→都心：04072_toshin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{土地代|とちだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Land prices in central Tokyo are high.

examples.japanese: {土地代|とちだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}い→払う：00535_harau⟧、⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: I'll pay for the land and plan to build the house later.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}せば→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧、{土地代|とちだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}くて→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}てられる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: If you move to the countryside, land is cheap and you can build a spacious house.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧ (land) + ⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧ (price, cost). The suffix ⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧ attaches to many cost-related nouns (⟦{電気|でんき}{代|だい}→電気代：09543_denkidai⟧, ⟦{交通|こうつう}{費|ひ}→交通費：03056_koutsuuhi⟧, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {土地代|とちだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧／⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧: land is expensive / cheap
- {土地代|とちだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay for the land
- {土地代|とちだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧／⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧: land prices rise / fall

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{地価|ちか}→地価：12130_chika⟧: land value — more formal, used in news and real-estate statistics
- ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧: rent (for a house/apartment) — recurring rental cost, not a purchase price
- ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: real-estate price — broader, includes buildings as well as land
